--- round robin table ---

CREATE Table round_rob
(
    id INT,
    name varchar(4000),
    salary INT
)
WITH
( 
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
)

-- Replicate Table --

CREATE SCHEMA first1replicate;

CREATE TABLE first1replicate.repli_table
(
    dim_key INT,
    dim_name VARCHAR(4000),
    dim_salary INT
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE
)

--- Hash table ---
CREATE TABLE HASH_first
(
    hash_key INT,
    hash_name VARCHAR(4000),
    hash_sal  INT
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(hash_key)
)
